description: For bid walkthrough, this checklist records observable conditions, scope interfaces, measurement needs, protection, logistics, assumptions, and questions. Its supporting evidence includes annotated plans, measurements, photos, attendee notes, hazardous-material disclosures, and addendum references.

title: Bid Walkthrough Checklist
use_case: Use the checklist during pre-bid site walkthrough and constraint capture when the bid walkthrough record must identify bid package, site zones, existing systems, access routes, working hours, utilities, and owner-furnished information. Complete the applicable handoff for bid assumptions, RFI list, estimate handoff, risk allowance, addendum tracking, and acknowledgment record.
